text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe for Now This is Alice Springs Chicken. It features boneless skinless chicken breasts, which are a staple in your recipe history, and is topped with a rich and savory mixture of bacon, mushrooms, and cheese. The combination of flavors and textures sounds like a great match for your tastes. While it does take a bit longer to prepare, the end result is likely to be worth the extra time, and the serving size is substantial, so you may even have leftovers for another meal.
